description: Example 3. Adding a transform to filter the date. This allows us to show a subset of the full date range from the source data. Works by selecting our column with the special 'datum' argument, and extracting just the 'year', then filtering for values above a given value, e.g. 1990.  // Have also switched the 'y' field to 'CAPE' - this adjusted PE measure divides the price by the average inflation-adjusted earnings of the previous 10 years.

title.text: US stock prices are high relative to earnings
title.subtitle: Cyclically adjusted price-to-earnings ratio (CAPE), S&P composite, 1950 onwards. Source: Robert Shiller
